title: News Reflection: Pia Cayetano feels the pressure right now
summary: The senator tells her colleagues, she feels she's being treated like a 'fugitive'

blocks.text: The senator tells her colleagues, she feels she's being treated like a 'fugitive'

Senator Pia Cayetano never expected to be in the tough, tense situation she finds herself in right now: treated like a common fugitive by Philippine authorities when she traveled to Singapore, she tells the Senate impeachment court.

But why? Malacañang press officer Claire Castro has a hunch: her family? Oh my God (whom her brother Alan Peter Cayetano likes to quote). “Is this a sign of paranoia?” the Marcos administration spokesperson wonders. This week’s News Reflection, with Paterno Esmaquel II. – Rappler.com
